svg.aria-label: How the app is built: nine modules with dependencies pointing inwards; one search goes down to the API and comes back as one screen state; one request runs at a time
svg.text: Coolblue product search · Android · Kotlin + Jetpack Compose
search/ui and search/data never depend on each other
search/domain and core/domain (grey) are plain Kotlin, no Android
the only module that sees everything, so Hilt can build the graph
main ones only; not drawn: app → core/ui, core/network
test helper, used by search/ui tests only
Down to the API, back as one screen state
your action travels down to the mock API
one AppResult, then one SearchUiState the screen draws
One request at a time, the newest wins
a new request cancels the one in flight
at most one runs; a stale response never overwrites newer results
Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Material 3 · Hilt · Retrofit · OkHttp · Coil · 36 unit tests · CI on every push
